blocks.text: Liza Soberano has expanded her digital presence to connect with more fans, officially joining the HYBE-owned global fandom platform Weverse. The actress launched her own community on the platform on Wednesday, Nov. 9. She marked the milestone with her first-ever post shared on Tuesday, Nov. 10. “Hiiii everyone!! So happy we finally have our own little space here,” she wrote, also sharing a mirror selfie.
